assignments.brief_reason: Uses a factuality-versus-hate-speech cue to decide what to remove.
Removes low-substance insult-only posts as a toxicity/low-quality criterion.
Removal for incoherent/radicalized or possibly mentally ill language doesn’t clearly match threat/toxicity or violence exceptions.
Allows rude/cussing but draws a line when it becomes hateful direct disrespect.
Discounts/removes posts based on attack/fear-mongering tone rather than argument quality.
Specifically looks for threatening content and other-side-focused threats/offside cues.
Explicit removal criteria include defamatory/threatening content and excessively negative content.
Critiques inconsistent pair moderation and calls for applying the same standard across viewpoints.
Describes a mirror-test self-regulation method rather than a moderation threshold tied to threats/toxicity/violence.
Uses an offense/inflammatory/danger threshold with preference for minimal moderation when harms aren’t present.
Focuses on provable lies and keeping both sides; not clearly about threats/violence/toxicity removals.
Broadly allows both perspectives grounded in general free speech.
Permits opposing views but sets red lines against calls for violence and property damage.
Treats excessive abuse and projected violence as grounds for filtering.
Pairwise comparison by similarity/difference doesn’t specify a threat/toxicity removal rule.
General multi-factor content/context/tone analysis without specifying the moderation exception types.
Explains influence via polarization framing rather than a concrete removal exception.
Exception criteria target extreme language/hate speech and inappropriate targeting (toxicity/hate).
Directly cites hate-baiting and fear-mongering as cues driving removal.
Weighs honest debate spirit while rejecting inflammatory/curse-word language (toxicity/insult language).
